description.value:
Cost 2 Zeal

Frequency once per day

Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet rolls a check, attack roll, or saving throw.

Force a die result up to a floor of 15 for you or an ally.

Treat the triggering roll's die result as a 15, if that would be better for the roller than the actual result. This is a fortune effect.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Trigger you/an ally within 30 feet rolls: treat the die as a 15 if that's better for the roller" is P-DIE (redefines the rolled die's own value rather than shifting a success tier or rerolling; confirmed absent via exhaustive grep across pf2e-source this pass) and, for the ally-facing half, additionally P-CROSS (a different creature's already-rolled die). Separately blocked by P-ZEAL for the Cost 2 Zeal clause.
